sources.title: Fibonacci Retracement
sources.summary: Retracement percentages interpolate the range between selected extremes. Anchor choice determines levels. Our delayed confirmed pivots and admission thresholds are lab hypotheses, not a claim that publisher examples qualify these methods.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.title: Confirmed Pivots and Historical State
sources.summary: Pivot confirmation occurs after the selected right-side bars have closed. An anchor's price time and knowledge time differ. Counters and stored state can track closed events without retroactively making them available.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.title: Sessions
sources.summary: Session membership depends on time ranges, timezone and bar closure. Developing session extrema must include only observed closed bars. Our fixed UTC/session grouping is explicitly not an exchange or broker calendar qualification.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.title: Average True Range
sources.summary: Range-based volatility describes price movement, not direction. Comparison of separate closed range windows is a reproducible volatility hypothesis; expansion after compression does not guarantee a profitable breakout.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.title: Tick Volume
sources.summary: Tick volume counts observed price changes rather than traded shares or contracts. Relative activity rules must preserve provider semantics. Missing volume is not zero-cost execution or demonstrated market participation.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.title: Historical Event Counters
sources.summary: State counters can record elapsed bars since an observed event. Our loss recovery, transition wait and signal persistence rules use mature local history; their lengths and utility remain experimental.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.title: Repainting and Confirmed Data
sources.summary: Unconfirmed observations, later pivot labels and future context can make history appear better than executable decisions. Our feature owner uses only closed data and retains delayed availability.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.title: Probability Calibration
sources.summary: Scores are not automatically calibrated probabilities. Training and calibration evidence are necessary before a model-based admission filter is trusted; this catalog supplies an availability guard, not a trained classifier.
sources.license: Original curator paraphrase; linked publisher material retains its rights; no publisher code, chart outcomes or transcript copied.

sources.summary: Model selection and transformations must not use final test outcomes. Exposure provenance and original artifact availability are distinct from a method's source citation or new revision hash.
